name: MD-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 12-point Democratic lean plus a favorable national environment
First-term incumbent Elfreth with a large fundraising edge ($1.1M vs ~$13K)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~95%
No general-election polls, so forecast rests on fundamentals
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to the incumbent: a D+12 district, a Democratic-leaning environment, and a massive money advantage over a barely funded challenger. Markets agree, pricing Elfreth near certain, so the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a much tighter race or a sharp national shift toward Republicans would warrant moving this toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Sarah Elfreth, a first-term Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored in a Maryland district that leans Democratic by about 12 points. She has raised over $1.1 million and holds more than $335,000 on hand, while Republican Berney Flowers has raised roughly $12,700 with about $2,000 remaining. No outside groups are meaningfully engaged, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price Elfreth's chances at about 95 percent. With no general-election polling available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided financial picture, all of which point to a comfortable Democratic win.
